crops.name: Hardneck Garlic
crops.outdoor_action: Separate heads into individual cloves just before planting. Plant pointy side up, 5cm deep, and top with 10cm of straw or leaf mulch.
crops.touch_grass_tip: Feel the soil dampness with your knuckles: soil should be cool and moist, not waterlogged.

crops.name: Lacinato 'Dino' Kale
crops.outdoor_action: Transplant seedlings or direct sow seeds. Cover with floating row cloth if cabbage moths are active.
crops.touch_grass_tip: Frost converts plant starches into sugars. Pick leaves right after the first light frost for peak sweetness!

crops.name: Bloomsdale Long Standing Spinach
crops.outdoor_action: Sow in shallow furrows. Press soil down firmly with your palm to ensure good seed-to-soil contact.
crops.touch_grass_tip: Spinach germinates best in cold soil. Even in autumn freezes, roots survive beneath snow blankets.

crops.name: Scarlet Nantes Fall Carrot
crops.outdoor_action: Mix tiny seeds with sand for even distribution. Keep surface evenly moist for 10-14 days until tiny green ferns emerge.
crops.touch_grass_tip: Overwintering trick: Cover the carrot bed with 20cm of shredded autumn leaves. You can harvest sweet carrots all winter straight from frozen ground!

crops.name: Rustic Wild Arugula (Rocket)
crops.outdoor_action: Broadcast seeds lightly over raked earth. Gently rake surface to cover and water with a fine mist.
crops.touch_grass_tip: Rub freshly pinched leaves between your fingers to smell the peppery aroma outdoors.

crops.name: French Breakfast Radish
crops.outdoor_action: Fastest crop in the autumn garden! Poke holes with your pinky finger 1cm deep and drop seeds.
crops.touch_grass_tip: Harvest in just 3-4 weeks. Pull crisp radishes with your bare hands and wash them with the garden hose.

crops.name: Aquadulce Claudia Fava Beans
crops.outdoor_action: Inoculate seeds with Rhizobium bacteria. Plant 5cm deep in double rows. Acts as a nitrogen fixer for spring soil.
crops.touch_grass_tip: Overwintering fava beans build deep taproots that loosen heavy clay soil during rainy winter months.

crops.name: Cereal Winter Rye (Cover Crop)
crops.outdoor_action: Scatter seeds generously over cleared garden beds. Walk across the bed in boots to press seeds into soil.
crops.touch_grass_tip: Prevents autumn soil erosion, suppresses winter weeds, and scavenges leftover nitrogen for spring veggies.

crops.name: Mâche / Lamb's Lettuce
crops.outdoor_action: Scatter seeds in rows, lightly press down. Keep bed moist until sprouting occurs.
crops.touch_grass_tip: Nutty, delicate winter green that thrives in freezing temperatures when all other greens shut down.

crops.name: French Red Shallots
crops.outdoor_action: Plant bulb sets so tips barely peek out above the soil surface. Mulch lightly with dry autumn leaves.
crops.touch_grass_tip: Each single bulb will multiply underground into a cluster of 6-8 gourmet shallots by next June.
